title: Vesper
subtitle: One diamond at the hollow of the throat, catching the last light of the day.
description: A single round brilliant suspended in eighteen-karat white gold, the design pared back until only the stone and the light remain. There is no halo, no ornament to argue with — just a diamond set to hang exactly where the collarbones meet, turning gently as the wearer moves. Bez Ambar's cutting shows in the return of light: clean, full, unhurried. It is a pendant made to be worn from morning through evening and to read, always, as one quiet point of brilliance.
